title: Batched NN 4D-Var: a performant hybrid model framework for the Integrated Forecasting System
abstract: arXiv:2610.32582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid forecasting systems combining machine learning and numerical weather prediction offer a promising route toward improved forecast skill while preserving physical consistency. In this study, we investigate online learning of state-dependent model-error corrections within the Integrated Forecasting System using 4D-Var. Building on previous work, we represent model error using a neural network embedded within the forecast model and trained from observations through the data assimilation cycle. First, we introduce a targeted variant of neural-network 4D-Var in which only the neural-network parameters are estimated, while the atmospheric state is provided by a precomputed analysis. We then propose a batched extension that processes assimilation windows in random order and averages parameter increments over multiple windows, drawing inspiration from mini-batch stochastic optimization. Experiments are conducted with the Integrated Forecas

translated_title: 批处理神经网络四维变分（Batched NN 4D-Var）：面向综合预报系统的高性能混合模式框架
translated_abstract: 结合机器学习与数值天气预报的混合预报系统，为在保持物理一致性的同时提升预报技巧提供了一条有前景的途径。在本研究中，我们利用四维变分（4D-Var）方法研究了在综合预报系统（Integrated Forecasting System, IFS）内对依赖于状态的模式误差订正进行在线学习。在以往工作的基础上，我们使用一个嵌入预报模式内部的神经网络来表示模式误差，并通过资料同化循环利用观测对其进行训练。首先，我们引入了一种针对性的神经网络四维变分变体，其中仅估计神经网络参数，而大气状态由预先计算的分析场提供。随后，我们提出了一种批处理扩展方法，该方法以随机顺序处理多个同化窗口，并对多个窗口上的参数增量取平均，其灵感来自小批量随机优化。实验在综合预报系统上开展（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了批处理神经网络四维变分框架，通过在综合预报系统中嵌入神经网络表示模式误差，并以随机顺序处理多个同化窗口、对参数增量取平均实现在线学习，构建了高性能的机器学习与数值预报混合模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a batched neural-network 4D-Var framework that embeds a neural network to represent model error in the Integrated Forecasting System and performs online learning by processing assimilation windows in random order and averaging parameter increments, yielding a performant hybrid ML-NWP framework.
